---
title: "Figure 4c: `WT` NeRh50 maximum amplitudes and decay rate constants in response to changes in lipid-protein ratio (LPR)"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false

# Use helper script to load dataframes
source("assets/r/load_dataframes.R")
dfms <- load_dataframes()

options(ggplot2.discrete.colour = wesanderson::wes_palette("AsteroidCity1"))
```

Manuscript figure 4c shows `WT` maximum amplitude and decay rate constant variation over `LPR5`, `LPR10`, and `LPR50` for the `WT` NeRh50 with NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup> (figure 4c).

## The Dataset

The data used for the figure are shown in @tbl-data-4c

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data-4c
#| tbl-cap: "Maximum amplitude and decay rate constant at three LPR values, for WT Rh50 (figure 4c)."

DT::datatable(dfms$dfm_4c, options=list(pageLength=5))
```

### Downloads

- [download data](assets/data/fig_4c.csv)

## The Models

We use linear models for amplitude and decay rate as dependent variables, with LPR as the independent factor, checking fit in @fig-model-4c.

```{r}
#| label: fig-model-4c
#| fig-cap: "Diagnostic plots for linear model fits of `amplitude ~ LPR` and `decayrate ~ LPR`. The splines for linearity/heteroscadicity are odd, but the datapoints are not concerning. There is some evidence of non-normality of residuals in the decay rate data, but nothing especially concerning." 
#| fig-subcap:
#|    - "`amplitude ~ LPR`"
#|    - "`decayrate ~ LPR`"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
#| layout-ncol: 2

# Fit the models
model4c_amp_lm <- lm(amplitude ~ LPR, data=dfms$dfm_4c)
model4c_k_lm <- lm(decayrate ~ LPR, data=dfms$dfm_4c)

# Check model fit
performance::check_model(model4c_amp_lm)
performance::check_model(model4c_k_lm)
```

As the model fit is acceptable, we estimate contrasts in @tbl-contrasts-4c.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-contrasts-4c
#| tbl-cap: "Contrasts for model fits, with Sidak adjustment. No contrast includes zero in the 95% confidence interval estimate." 
#| tbl-subcap:
#|    - "Maximum amplitude"
#|    - "Decay rate"

EMM <- emmeans::emmeans(model4c_amp_lm, ~ LPR)
confint(emmeans::contrast(EMM, "pairwise", adjust="sidak")) |>
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=3) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("hover", "responsive")
  )

EMM <- emmeans::emmeans(model4c_k_lm, ~ LPR)
confint(emmeans::contrast(EMM, "pairwise", adjust="sidak")) |>
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=3) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("hover", "responsive")
  )
```

As no contrast includes zero in the 95% confidence interval, we conclude that there are differences in amplitude and decay rate constant for each pairwise comparison between LPR condition. 

## The Figures

We plot the differences, indicating P-values for the contrasts in @fig-plot-4c.

```{r}
#| label: fig-plot-4c
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "WT measurements across three LPRs, replicating figure 4c from the manuscript." 
#| fig-subcap:
#|    - "Figure 4c, maximum amplitude"
#|    - "Figure 4c, decay rate"
#| fig-width: 3
#| fig-height: 4
#| layout-ncol: 2

# Get p-values, accounting for heteroscedasticity and multiple testing
# Also generate group1 and group2 columns
EMM_amp <- as.data.frame(pairs(emmeans::emmeans(model4c_amp_lm, ~ LPR),
                               adjust="sidak")) |>
  tidyr::separate(contrast, into=c("group1", "group2"), sep=" - ") |>
  dplyr::mutate(y.position=2.5) |>
  rstatix::add_significance()

EMM_k <- as.data.frame(pairs(emmeans::emmeans(model4c_k_lm, ~ LPR),
                               adjust="sidak")) |>
  tidyr::separate(contrast, into=c("group1", "group2"), sep=" - ") |>
  dplyr::mutate(y.position=85) |>
  rstatix::add_significance()

p4c_amp <- ggplot2::ggplot(dfms$dfm_4c, 
                           ggplot2::aes(x=LPR, y=amplitude, color=LPR)) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter() +
  ggplot2::labs(y="Maximum amplitude (nA)") +
  ggplot2::ylim(0, 3.5) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(EMM_amp,
                             label="p = {scales::pvalue(p.value)}",
                             size=3, step.increase=0.1)

p4c_k <- ggplot2::ggplot(dfms$dfm_4c, 
                         ggplot2::aes(x=LPR, y=decayrate, color=LPR)) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter() +
  ggplot2::labs(y="Decay rate constant k (/s)") +
  ggplot2::ylim(0, 105) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(EMM_k, 
                             label="p = {scales::pvalue(p.value)}", 
                             size=3, step.increase=0.1)

p4c_amp
p4c_k

# Write figures to file (commented out for webpage)
#ggplot2::ggsave("assets/images/fig4c_WT_maximum_amplitude.pdf", p4c_amp)
#ggplot2::ggsave("assets/images/fig4c_WT_maximum_amplitude.png", p4c_amp)
#ggplot2::ggsave("assets/images/fig4c_WT_decay_rate_constant.pdf", p4c_k)
#ggplot2::ggsave("assets/images/fig4c_WT_decay_rate_constant.png", p4c_k)
```
